message:
Now let me understand the vulnerability better. The key issue is in `mrb_memsearch_ss`:

1. `s0 = (bitint*)(ys)` - reads 8 bytes at a time from the start of the search buffer
2. `s1 = (bitint*)(ys+m-1)` - reads 8 bytes starting at `ys+m-1` (where m is the pattern length)

The loop iterates `for (i=0; i < n; i+=sizeof(bitint))`. The problem is:
- When `n` (the haystack length) is not a multiple of 8, the last iteration reads past the end of the buffer
- `s1` reads 8 bytes starting at `ys+m-1`, which can read up to 7 bytes past the end of the buffer

Let me look at the oss-fuzz testcase to understand what input format is expected:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>ls -la /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/oss-fuzz/ && cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/oss-fuzz/*.cc 2>/dev/null | head -100</｜｜DSML｜｜>
